paper_title: Lattice Agreement in Message Passing Systems
statement: We have presented algorithms for the lattice agreement problem and the generalized lattice agreement problem. These algorithms achieve significantly better time complexity than previous algorithms. For future work, we would like to know the answers to the following two questions: 1) Is log f rounds a lower bound for lattice agreement in synchronous message passing systems? 2) Is O(f ) message delays optimal for the lattice agreement and generalized lattice agreement problem in asynchronous message passing systems?
